item.title: New subpoenas issued in inquiry on response to 2016 Russian election interference, AP sources say
item.description: The Justice Department has issued new subpoenas in a Florida-based investigation into perceived adversaries of President Donald Trump and the U.S. government response to Russian interference in the 2016 presidential election, according to multiple people familiar with the matter.
